$comment: Alpha builds (D133). tools/package/build-alpha.mjs reads this: version = <base>-alpha.<n>, n = --n or `current`. Each build needs a matching '## <version>' section in data/release/CHANGELOG-alpha.md. nodeMin mirrors package.json engines. obsRuntime names the vendored OBS runtime the zip copies from (configured runtime dir, app/host/lib/config.mjs).

obsRuntime.note: The vendored runtime folder is named for 32.1.2 and the host build links against the obs-studio checkout at that tag; the runtime binaries were not rebuilt from source here.
